summary: Voice input loads its audio worklet from /audio-worklet-processor.js, which the host must serve. The path is now the exported DEFAULT_AUDIO_WORKLET_URL and can be changed with DeepgramSttAdapter's workletUrl option.
howTo: Add predev and prebuild scripts that copy node_modules/glirastes/dist/react/audio-worklet-processor.js into public/ (see the speech worklet section of the building-glirastes-chat-ui references). If the file is served elsewhere, construct DeepgramSttAdapter with workletUrl and pass it as the chat's voice.adapter.
